heading: Today
text: Some early sun east. Showers spreading east, tapering off west, with a glimpse of sun.

heading: Thursday Night
text: A few evening showers, partial clearing, a little fog.

heading: Friday
text: Clouds, a few breaks of sun. A chance of showers in southern NH.

heading: Saturday
text: Showers likely south and west of I-89, chance north and east.
